notes: *no, not* was read as the ASV's emphatic restatement of the clause's one `לֹא` under rule 25; the alternative keeps all five words of *no not so much as* on `עַד`. The unit's note records the competing reading, as rule 8 requires.

`מִדְרַךְ כַּף־רָגֶל` is restructured by the ASV: `כַּף` takes the recast relational *for* (rule 19's other-preposition clause, or rule 33 read the same way) and `מִדְרָךְ` the infinitival *to tread on*.
